description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for filtering and sorting employee timesheet lists within the OrangeHRM time management system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee numbers and actionable states, along with default sorting behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetListSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying filtering parameters when retrieving employee timesheet lists, including employee IDs and action states, with default sorting by start date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes default sorting parameters for the filter, setting the sort field to 'timesheet.startDate' and sort order to descending.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee IDs to filter by.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee IDs for filtering.

methods.name: getActionableStatesList
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable states used for filtering.

methods.name: setActionableStatesList
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable states for filtering.
